workflow.name: DeFi Pooled Value Conservation Hunt v2
workflow.description: Focused hunt for permissionless pooled-value extraction in evidenced custody contracts, with invariant fan-out, hostile arithmetic verification, fork proof, program gate, and relative ranking. Import-valid v2.2: globally unique stage keys, a single dedup consume-all boundary, explicit proxy/storage/initialization coverage, and per-operation cross-contract neighborhoods for composition analysis.

steps.name: Freeze pooled-value program scope
Map evidenced pooled-value custody surfaces
steps.content:
Map only in-scope deployed contracts that custody or account for pooled user/protocol value between transactions, plus permissionless operations that change that value. Derive the contract set from current code and supplied deployment evidence; do not hard-code Pendle directories or assume prior router/custody conclusions remain true. Trace deposited assets, shares/tokens, reserves, internal totals, conversions, indexes, rounding, fees, oracle inputs, callbacks, and terminal transfers. Provide custody/TVL evidence and exact conservation/pricing invariants. Exclude atomic pass-through operations only when proven for this commit and deployment.

Use deterministic enumeration before reasoning: ripgrep plus language-aware AST/compiler tooling when available. Perform {{extra.repeat_runs}} independent enumeration passes when supplied (default: 2), compare their coverage, and record any coverage gap.

Web3 architecture expansion: identify whether the operation is reached through a transparent proxy, UUPS proxy, beacon, diamond/facet, minimal clone, metamorphic deployment, delegatecall-based module, or direct implementation. Trace proxy -> implementation/facet resolution, initializer state, upgrade authorization, storage slots/layout across relevant versions, selector routing, and every attacker-influenceable delegatecall target. Check deployed bytecode/configuration evidence rather than assuming source deployment.

For each operation, include its local cross-contract neighborhood: direct callers and callees, callbacks/hooks, shared storage/accounting dependencies, tokens/oracles/bridges it trusts, and related public operations that can prepare or consume its state. Follow at least two contract hops where source and deployment evidence permit. Populate the proxy/storage and cross-contract output fields even when the conclusion is "direct deployment / no relevant edge", with evidence.

steps.name: Pooled-value hypotheses A: round-trip conservation
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of {{surface_operation_label}}. Hunt exact round-trip or conservation breaks that let an unprivileged actor receive more pooled value than supplied: mint/burn asymmetry, share inflation, first-depositor/donation, rounding accumulation, fee/index double count, reserve/internal-balance desync, or repeated boundary cycles. Require exact math and rounding direction, fund source, victim, sequence, realistic magnitude, locations, guards, and falsification target.

steps.name: Pooled-value hypotheses B: pricing and composition
Deduplicate pooled-value root causes
steps.content: Cluster {{multi_output_depth_2}} by faulty value math/state operation, attacker primitive, victim/fund source, invariant, and fix. Preserve alternate profitable cycles and evidence conflicts. Create fingerprints; remove duplicates, unexplained balances, out-of-scope dependency assumptions, unproven deployment paths, and known accepted behavior.

steps.name: Independent pooled-value verification
steps.content: Try to falsify {{dedup_canonical_hypothesis_id}} using these required gates: deployed in-scope custody; attacker-controlled state; named pooled-value victim; exact rounding direction at every boundary; round-trip conservation; oracle/flash feasibility; state/callback order; audit/known-issue dedup; realistic net gain and impact under supplied thresholds. Record pass/fail/blocked/not-applicable per gate with calculations. supported requires a complete permissionless loss path. Produce a pinned fork plan.

steps.name: Fork conservation PoC
steps.content:
Implement/run the smallest pinned fork/local test for supported candidates. Measure attacker and pool/victim balances, total supply/reserves/indexes, conservation invariant before/after, repayments/fees/gas/slippage, and repeatability. Use only authorized local fork calls. Set PoC verdict and retain trace/artifacts/minimal reproduction.

Cost gate: if {{dedup_triage_priority}} is not `high`, do not build or run a harness. Return poc_verdict=`skipped_by_priority` with the reason. For smart-contract candidates, use {{extra.fork_rpc_url}} and {{extra.fork_block}} when supplied.

steps.name: Apply pooled-value program gate
steps.content:
Apply the immutable program scope contract to this technically verified candidate.
Program evidence is read directly from immutable extras after dedup: snapshot={{extra.program_rules_snapshot}}; checked_at={{extra.program_rules_checked_at}}; URL={{extra.bug_bounty_url}}; deployment={{extra.deployment_evidence}}; known_issues={{extra.known_issues_snapshot}}; testing_constraints={{extra.authorized_test_constraints}}.
Candidate: {{dedup_canonical_summary}}. Root cause: {{dedup_canonical_root_cause}} at {{dedup_canonical_location}}.
Technical verdict: {{verify_technical_verdict}}. Production reachability: {{verify_production_reachability}}.
Observed effect: {{poc_observed_effect}}. Reproduction verdict: {{poc_poc_verdict}}. Reproduction evidence: {{poc_poc_evidence}}.

Set eligibility_verdict=eligible only when the exact affected asset is in scope, the observed effect matches a named accepted impact, no exclusion or known-issue rule controls, and required deployment facts are evidenced. Use ineligible for a controlling exclusion or absent impact; use blocked for missing program/deployment facts. Assign severity only from the supplied program language and measured impact. Do not use popularity, theoretical TVL, scanner confidence, or remembered platform conventions.

steps.name: Report verified pooled-value exploit
